Clareon By The Coast by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Clareon By The Coast rests in Seacrest, between Prominence and Rosemary Beach. Surrounded by endless dining, shopping and entertainment, you’ll always find something to do. Take a short three-minute walk to the nearby beach access or spend the day splashing around in the private backyard pool. The woodsy back patio is perfect for family gatherings, with lounge chairs for the whole family. Inside, the spacious living, kitchen, and dining area has a calming blue, grey and green interior. The primary bedroom, king, has a TV with a private full bath. Upstairs, a guest room, queen, shares a Jack and Jill bath with the bunkroom, both with TVs. Welcome!

Our dedicated team at Oversee 30A, a local company, is committed to ensuring your stay is nothing short of exceptional. We strive for perfection and are just a stone's throw away should you require any assistance. Reach out to us anytime, seven days a week, with the added peace of a 24/7 emergency line. Overview: - 200 steps to Private deeded beach access and 211 steps to the Seacrest Drive Beach Access - 3 bedroom, 2.5 bath - 1580 sq ft - Private pool (can be heated seasonally for an additional $55.00 per day, contact Oversee for details) - Charcoal grill - Wi-Fi - 3 bikes included - Dogs considered, an additional $210 non-refundable fee for each pet Overnight: - King in 1st floor primary bedroom; bath; TV - Queen in 2nd floor guest room; shared bath; TV - Full/twin bunk with twin trundle in 2nd-floor guest room; shared bath; TV - Sleeper-sofa in living room Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Checkout is 10:00 AM CST.
